title: Legacy crash retrievals: luring craft with psionics, then downing them with directed energy

tellings.quote: almost creating this like honeypot of like hey we love you come see us

plain: The claim is that a long-running secret government effort to recover UFOs, called the legacy programme, lures craft in the desert using people with psychic abilities, setting up "this like honeypot of like hey we love you come see us", and then brings them down with directed-energy weapons. Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into the UFO programme as a child, tells Michels this, passing on what the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart has said. If true, some crashed craft were not accidents but were trapped.
